主要内容: Subaru of America, Inc. reported 56,558 vehicle sales for May 2021, an 8.8 percent increase compared to May 2020. The automaker also reported year-to-date sales of 278,373, a 30.6 percent gain compared with the same period in 2020. Forester was the top performer by volume with 20,006 sales, a 12 percent increase over the prior year and its best-ever May. WRX/STI achieved its best May ever with 3,169 sales, a 40.5 percent increase compared to May 2020. Outback posted a 23 percent increase, while Crosstrek posted a 5.6 percent increase compared to May 2020. The global microchip shortage continued to impact production and inventory levels throughout the auto industry. Subaru of America, Inc. also announced its continued partnership with The Leukemia & Lymphoma Society (LLS) for the sixth consecutive year during Subaru Loves to Care month in June, supporting over 40,000 blood cancer patients through blankets and messages of hope.
